name: pushBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: ALLOWPUSHBOXES id list: the cube may only slide while its next position is inside one of these boxes. | count (+4): Entry count of pushBoxes; 0 means unrestricted.

name: slideSpeed
meaning: 800 on a push; after the bounce it decelerates at 4000 u/s^2. In state 3 it accelerates to 800 at 400 u/s^2.

name: fallTime
meaning: Airborne time in g_dt ticks, reset on floor contact. Gravity = fallTime*4000>>12 clamped to [200,1500]; capped at 0x100 in water.

name: homePos
meaning: Position after the ground snap in Init; restored by Reset.

name: slideDir
meaning: 12-bit slide heading (away from the pusher, snapped to 90 degrees); reversed once on a wall.

name: frozenRiver
meaning: The level's FrozenRiver (class 0x53) if any. Non-NULL disables kicking and the kick prompt; it receives msg 0x36 when the cube sinks.

name: splashVisible
meaning: Draws and animates the shared splash body.

name: splashReady
meaning: 1 when the splash record (export 0x5A) was built in Init.
